title: MODE 5-2: Log (Logarithmic Regression)
summary: Enter x , y DT pairs (≥2, all x > 0), AC, then recall A, B, and r. Fitted curve: y = A + B ln x.

body.text: Log fits y = A + B ln x — growth that is steep at first and then flattens. Typical uses: sensory response, learning curves, and other diminishing-returns trends.

Log regression fits y = A + B ln x. The curve rises quickly for small x, then bends and flattens — useful when extra units of x matter less and less (diminishing returns). All x values must be positive.

body.caption: Sample fit y = 2 + 3 ln x. Notice how the slope eases off as x increases — that is the hallmark log shape.

body.text: Open Log regression, clear old data, enter at least two pairs as x , y DT. All x values must be greater than zero.
